actualAgentCoreReceivingOwner.name: SkillService and Learning proposal lifecycle

entries.currentGapVsAlreadyCovered: P3 version-safe Skill lifecycle is complete and must not be replaced. A distinct runtime retrieval gap exists: external-context Skill selection calls rankKnowledge, which uses BM25 and filters score=0; input contains only name, description and allowedTools. Voyager performs semantic description retrieval, so it can generate candidates for paraphrases with no lexical overlap. Extend the existing native Skill/context selector with optional semantic candidate generation using existing embedding facilities, while preserving exact Skill digest, applicability checks and a lexical fallback. This is structural capability coverage, not a measured superiority claim.

actualAgentCoreReceivingOwner.name: Canonical Memory retrieval and usage feedback

entries.currentGapVsAlreadyCovered: Native fusion/MMR exists, but canonical retrieval.ts maxSemanticRedundancy returns 0 when the candidate vector is missing and skips selected items without vectors. Exact duplicateSignature only removes exact normalized record signatures, leaving lexical near-duplicates unpenalized during missing/degraded embeddings. Grok mmr.rs implements token-Jaccard diversity without embeddings. Extend/replace the same native redundancy helper with a bounded lexical fallback when semantic comparison is unavailable, using existing tokenization and preserving semantic behavior when vectors exist. No second ranker/store; no empirical quality claim without outcome evidence.

entries.name: web-content-extractor — Wrtn Labs
entries.mechanism: lib.ts parses with cheerio, strips non-content tags, computes text/link density, selects maximal-density subtrees, restores document order and returns text, HTML fragments and links. Density is based on descendant text/tag ratios. Extraction flattens whitespace; links retain raw hrefs without base-URL resolution or source-range provenance.
entries.gapVsAlreadyCovered: Two concrete gaps: native safe public HTTP acquisition and optional boilerplate reduction for article-like pages. Current projection preserves Markdown structure/base links but does not select main content. Selectively adapt donor density/ancestor selection inside DocumentProjection using the already-installed node-html-markdown public translator hook, subject to operational evidence-retention checks. This can improve the existing engine without adding a parallel parser/runtime.
entries.license: MIT full license inspected. Any future copied portions require copyright/license retention.
entries.coupling: Donor code itself imports cheerio/domhandler, but direct reuse of its parser is unnecessary: installed node-html-markdown 2.0.0 exposes translator factory node/parent/visitor.rootNode and the existing parsed tree. Adapt density computations to structural node access; do not add/deep-import a parser dependency. Static feasibility established; extraction quality is not yet experimentally demonstrated.
entries.reviewNotes: Use an opt-in main-content mode in the existing projection owner. A bounded discovery pass through structural-tag hooks can select subtree outerHTML, followed by the unchanged converter so code/tables/links survive. Apply the explicit proposed eligibility/budget gates below; fall back to full content for any failed gate, missing root/hook, competing semantic regions, unselected table/index structure or budget exhaustion. Preserve original source digest and clearly label extraction scope. Avoid donor unconditional header/nav/footer/img/form stripping. Important hook trap: ctx.base does not preserve overwritten built-in factories; blanket overrides can break headings/lists/code/table behavior. Keep specialized factories intact. No donor/browser daemon is needed.
entries.availability: public-source-inspected
entries.recommendedAction: Batch1 may extend native acquisition and the single DocumentProjection HTML engine with opt-in bounded main-content selection. Operationally establish boilerplate reduction plus retained selected-content citations/tables/code/links before enabling. Full-content remains the explicit fallback, not a parallel ingestion engine.

existingDependencyEvidence.publicInterfaceEvidence: README custom translators; index.d.ts root exports TranslatorConfigFactory/TranslatorCollection; main.d.ts public translators; translator context node/parent; visitor rootNode. Type inference can avoid deep imports. Two-pass selected outerHTML avoids overwriting specialized factories.
existingDependencyEvidence.qualityGate: Static feasibility only, not measured gain. Operational result must reduce known navigation/sidebar boilerplate while retaining the selected article facts, citations, code, tables and absolute links. Bound traversal and cache postorder statistics rather than retaining donor repeated ancestor/descendant scans.

nativeSelectionProposal.status: Proposed conservative policy; no measured gain and not donor constants
nativeSelectionProposal.donorThreshold: Maximum densitySum node, then minimum density among that node and its ancestors. Nodes below threshold are pruned; select maximum-densitySum descendants and deduplicate ancestor/descendant overlap.

budgets.byteLimit: Reuse existing acquisition/projection byte cap; do not raise it for extraction.

nativeSelectionProposal.semanticSelection: Prefer exactly one outermost main/article with at least 300 non-whitespace text characters. Multiple competing regions fall back to full. Keep selected subtree structure intact.
nativeSelectionProposal.fullFallback: Any failed eligibility gate, missing/malformed root or hook, budget breach, multiple competing main regions, or table/index structure outside selection (except an explicitly scoped semantic main/article selection).
nativeSelectionProposal.provenance: Record mode main/full, selection/fallback reason, retained/dropped character counts, original byte hash, source URL and fetch metadata. Do not pretend main-content output is complete page evidence.
nativeSelectionProposal.rendering: Selection discovery through public structural-tag factories, then selected outerHTML through unchanged normal converter. Preserve link base resolution and specialized heading/list/table/code translators. Do not blanket-override tags or rely on ctx.base to preserve functional defaults.
